hooks.name: Spec test-cases.md required

action.prompt: A spec task just completed. Verify that the active spec folder contains a `test-cases.md` file alongside requirements.md, design.md, and tasks.md. If `test-cases.md` is MISSING, create it now following the `.kiro/steering/test-cases.md` standard: group by feature, detailed step-by-step scenarios, repeatability (unique-data generator or explicit clean-up/teardown), a dedicated regression group, and an MD-report-with-tables template. For API-only specs, scenarios must be API tests against the Dockerized app at http://localhost:8080 (docker compose up). For UI specs, scenarios are browser-engine steps whose run artifacts are MD reports with tables (not screenshots). Do not duplicate the file if it already exists.

hooks.description: Ensures every spec has a test-cases.md artifact; creates it from the steering standard if missing after a spec task completes.
